title: Supervised evidence-gated extraction with out-of-fold comparison against the strongest frozen baseline
rationale: The original zero-shot experiment did not exceed the frozen rule baseline. E27v2.1 tests whether supervised ontology-aware extraction can produce out-of-fold gains while retaining evidence grounding and schema validity.
integrity_statement: The original E27 result remains immutable. E27v2.1 is reported separately and every record is predicted by models that did not train on that record.

evaluation.fold_assignment: source-aware deterministic round robin using source_group only
evaluation.primary_comparator: B0 frozen rule and lexicon baseline
evaluation.supportive_test: paired bootstrap over segments with 5000 resamples
evaluation.success_definition: Both primary F1 values exceed B0 and both paired bootstrap probabilities of a non-positive gain are below 0.025.

fixed_model.evidence_gate: exact source spans and valid domain-range relations only
